1.explanation:
1. Select/Select.mdx – the main component documentation where states (default, disabled, invalid) live and where the warning state API should be added.  
2. ListBox/README.md – the underlying ListBox pattern on which Select is built; it shows how items render and how the wrapper handles focus and popover positioning.  
3. Form/Form.mdx – shows how Select is used within forms, and how field states (invalid, warning) map to form-level validation patterns.  
4. FormLabel/FormLabel.mdx – details the label markup/spacing anchoring the Select component’s label and helper text area.  
5. Icon/migrate-to-7.x.md – documents available icons and migration notes; needed to choose/add the warning icon (support-03, 16 px) into the Select.  
6. Dropdown/Dropdown.mdx – illustrates the dropdown/caret layout; useful to confirm spacing between the warning icon and the dropdown arrow and to ensure consistent padding and border behavior when adding new icons.
1.bug_scenario:
The bug is asking to add a “warning” visual state to the Select component. In the provided design mockups we see:
• A Select field with its label (“Label”) above it.
• The Select’s inner area showing “Choose an option.”
• To the right of the label text inside the input outline, a yellow warning icon (16 px square, with support-03 fill and black inner fill) placed 16 px from the right edge of the inner text field, with the dropdown caret to its right (8 px spacing between icon and caret).  
• Below the input border, a warning message (“Warning message here”) in the text-01 token color.  
• The border (and optionally the outline or shadow) of the Select may also switch to a warning color when in that state.  

In short, we need to extend the Select component’s API and styles to render a warning icon and helper text beneath, mirroring the existing “error” state behavior.
